platform: UNVERIFIED - printed book names players (NFLPA licence), consistent with the Genesis release; confirm which box/manual it came from
roster_basis: 1994 season roster after the April 1994 draft (Vikings page: Moon on MIN; 1994 rookies DeWayne Washington, Todd Steussie, David Palmer present). Confirm on every team page.
notes: Column labels are verified from the Vikings page; other team pages are assumed to use the same tables. prepare_book_source.py rejects any column it does not know, so a different layout cannot pass silently.
Printed scale observed on the Vikings page: 1..15 (weight in lb). A 0 or 16 is treated as a transcription error.
mapping 'equivalent' = the Madden 06 rating governs the same on-field outcome; 'approximate' = closest Madden 06 counterpart to a concept Madden 06 does not rate (lower confidence).

Not supplied by the book for some positions, therefore always estimated: QB awareness/strength; OL strength and agility; DL strength; DB agility/jumping; all hidden ratings (importance, stamina, injury, toughness).
